people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
translations.bsb: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
translations.kjv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
translations.asv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.
